dedupe_keys.name: queensland overseas exports and imports tables by port commodity industry

description: Queensland overseas exports and imports tables (by port, commodity, industry) is a group of 4 related entries of the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue, listed under the National Freight Data Hub group and published by Queensland Government Statistician's Office. Members: Overseas exports and imports of goods, value, Queensland and Australia, 1988–89 to 2019–20 (preliminary) (table); Overseas exports by port of loading, commodity (3-digit SITC revision 4) and country of destination, Queensland and Australia, 2008–09 to 2019–20 (preliminary) (table); Overseas imports by industry (4-digit ANZSIC 2006 edition) and country of origin, Queensland and other states and territories, 2008–09 to 2019–20 (preliminary) (table); Overseas imports by port of discharge, commodity (3-digit SITC revision 4) and country of origin, Queensland and Australia, 2008–09 to 2019–20 (preliminary) (table). Example entry: Statistical releases related to overseas merchandise exports and imports of goods originating from and destined for Queensland and other States and Territories. Coverage is Queensland, 2007 to 2022; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as annual, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2022-12-18. Files and pages listed: HTML (4 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support network flow and freight or traffic assignment models and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
